about: Code this package copies, one record per upstream file. Each copied Go file keeps its upstream copyright and license header and says what changed.

files.changes: killProcessTree, killDescendants and readProcChildren as functions, not ProcessServer methods, with no logger and the signal as a parameter, so one walk sends SIGTERM and later SIGKILL; exitStatus reports the signal by name instead of 128+n.
executionStream as outputStream: the limit is always set, the reader is closed by its owner, and the kept bytes are never nil so they marshal as an empty base64 string.
resolveByteLimit on ints with one maximum, returning the protocol's invalid error instead of a gRPC status.

The credential with supplementary groups, and the environment (PATH, HOME, USER, LOGNAME, then the request's variables over them). No credential when the user is the daemon's own; a switch without CAP_SETUID and CAP_SETGID is refused as denied; no cgroup, no oom/nice shell wrapper, no default variables from a service; Connect errors replaced by the protocol's kinds.
GetUserIdUints unexported; the user may also be a uid[:gid] that /etc/passwd lacks.
expand kept; ExpandAndResolve as resolveCwd with no default workdir, and a missing or non-directory cwd answered as not_found or invalid.
